en.title: K-V-G-J-V
en.decryption: Ascending order of social/political units: Family (Kula) -> Clan (Visha) -> Tribe (Jana).

fact.en: Rig Vedic society was NOT strictly caste-based; the Varna system was only beginning to emerge (fluid).
fact.hi: Rig Vedic society was NOT strictly caste-based; the Varna system was only beginning to emerge (fluid).

fact.en: Do not confuse 'Vidatha' (the oldest assembly) with 'Sabha' or 'Samiti'.

fact.en: The society was predominantly pastoral, not urban like the Indus Valley Civilization.
